# rd_glow_blur_ab, rd_glow_blur_gl (port/render/test/rd_glow_blur_ab.cmake):
# the glow's blur in two passes against today's chain.  A name a line; the
# words after it are this test's: nocull replays the fixture with
# ICO_RD_CULL=off in both arms (the generated lamps in the chain: the LAMPS
# plan's chain, no light of the lamps' own), a QUANTITY OP VALUE word declares
# what the fixture shows here (rd_fixture_list_props.cmake).
#
# the chain drawn whole: the sun's fans, a white ribbon over the middle of
# WORK2 (a saturated core: the bounds' worst case), at 21:9, 3:2 and 512x512
fx-opening-sun glow_chains>=1
fx-gate-102
fx-boot-0200 glow_chains>=1
# the lamps' chain (the cull off)
fx-163-blended nocull glow_chains>=1
fx-boot-0400 nocull glow_chains>=1
# no chain in two passes (a dark plan): drawn as recorded, the same bytes
